forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am currently experiencing some difficulties using the **NUCLEO-N657X0-Q** board.

I am using **STLinkUpgrade v3.17.10**, and the device ID is correctly recognized as 003500244142501120353451, as shown in the attached image.

However, when I click **"Open in update mode,"** the **PWR\_STATUS LED** on the Nucleo board turns off and the connection is dropped.

I am not sure if this specific update is critical for operation, but I would greatly appreciate any guidance or help to resolve this issue.

![스크린샷 2026-03-30 173607.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2395f04f-48b2-8f2a-60b6-cc2dc2f4ad84.png "스크린샷 2026-03-30 173607.png")![KakaoTalk_20260330_173520271.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/3cf715f8-fae5-b75a-86f1-b137246457fe.jpg "KakaoTalk_20260330_173520271.jpg")

scraped_replies.html:
@KDJEM.1 Thank you for the reply.

 

I didn't have a standalone STM32CubeProgrammer installed. I only had v2.2.3 (included with CubeIDE) and v2.2.4 (installed via update) together within the plugins folder.

 

I tried it in another environment where the STM32CubeProgrammer GUI is installed, and it solved the problem!

Thank you for your help!
